name: Switchback Merino Neck Tube
desc: A soft merino tube for cold starts, dusty connectors, and the moment the temperature drops ten degrees at elevation.

name: Two-Step Travel Boot Dryer
desc: A compact low-heat dryer that folds into a tail bag and rescues damp riding boots overnight.

name: Soft Ground Side-Stand Puck
desc: A broad little puck with a bright retrieval cord for gravel, grass, and other surfaces with opinions.

name: Cloudline Padded Helmet Sack
desc: A quilted helmet bag with a fleece interior, grab handles, and a flat pocket for earplugs and visor cloths.

name: Three-Minute Trail Stool
desc: A low folding perch for boots, lunch, maps, and staring thoughtfully at the motorcycle you just dropped.

name: Wrong Turn Waterproof Map Case
desc: A clear roll-top map sleeve for riders who consider a wrong turn an undocumented route enhancement.

name: Hush Little Engine Earplug Vault
desc: A machined pocket capsule that keeps reusable earplugs clean and attached to the keys you definitely remembered.

name: Bug Off Visor Field Kit
desc: Two tiny refillable bottles, a microfiber sleeve, and exactly enough smugness for a clean visor at the overlook.

name: Pack Light, Lie Less Scale
desc: A compact luggage scale for discovering which pannier contains all the objects you swore were essential.

name: Long Way Home Seat Pad
desc: A slim ventilated seat topper for days when the scenic route becomes substantially more scenic than planned.

name: Kickstand Coffee Camp Mug
desc: A squat insulated mug with a lid engineered for gravel-road coffee and questionable parking-lot breakfasts.

name: Miles & Mild Regrets Ride Log
desc: A weatherproof pocket notebook for fuel, routes, tire pressures, roadside discoveries, and things to tighten later.

name: Rainy Platform Gel Pen 0.38
desc: Muted blue-black needle-tip gel pen with a brass clip and dangerously smooth paper manners.

name: Persimmon Ink Fountain Pen
desc: Fine-nib fountain pen with warm persimmon-brown ink for notes that deserve better than ballpoint.

name: Tiny Orbit Mechanical Pencil
desc: 0.5 mm drafting pencil with a knurled grip, retractable tip, and tiny constellation marks.

name: Seoul Side-Street Pen Trio
desc: Three 0.38 mm gel pens in fog blue, roasted sesame, and subway green.

name: Margin Goblin Annotation Tabs
desc: Translucent tabs for passages you love, question, dispute, or intend to rant about later.

name: Field Anthropologist Index Cards
desc: Heavy dot-grid cards with observation / interpretation / question prompts on the reverse.

name: Moon Jar Brush Pen
desc: Flexible fine brush pen with charcoal-grey pigment ink and a porcelain-white barrel.

name: Pocket Ink Swatch Book
desc: Tiny accordion book of fountain-pen-friendly paper for recording inks and questionable acquisitions.

name: Jeju Volcanic Black Ink
desc: Deep soft-black fountain pen ink with subtle graphite shading.

name: Blue Hour Washi Library
desc: Six narrow washi rolls: twilight grid, mountain line, tiny stars, transit marks, clouds, and cobalt.

name: Brass Book Dart Tin
desc: Twenty-four paper-thin brass markers for finding the sentence again without adhesive.

name: Karst Fold-Out Travel Journal
desc: Accordion-fold sketch journal that becomes one continuous landscape when opened.

name: Quiet Kiln Fountain Pen Ink
desc: Smoky celadon-grey ink with gentle shading, named for a studio after everyone has gone home.

name: Three-Minute Morning Pages Pad
desc: Just enough room to write before your brain opens seventeen additional tabs.

name: Red Thread Bookbinding Kit
desc: Awl, waxed linen thread, needles, bone folder, and paper for two pocket notebooks.

name: Traveler’s Brass Ruler 10 cm
desc: Compact etched ruler that makes drawing a line feel far more ceremonial than necessary.

name: Soft-Spoken Highlighter Set
desc: Five muted highlighters that mark text without screaming fluorescently across the page.

name: Letterpress Tiny Compliments
desc: Palm-sized cards for very specific praise: excellent question, magnificent recovery, superb snack choice.

name: Ink Weather Desk Log
desc: A 90-day notebook for weather, mood, ink color, and one thing worth noticing.

name: Studio Pocket Scissors
desc: Compact paper scissors with blunt travel tips and a satisfying little sheath.

name: Emotional Support Tiny Vase

name: I Have a Spreadsheet for That Pin
desc: Hard-enamel pin for the person who already color-coded the contingency plan.

name: Mildly Concerned Mushroom Brooch
desc: A wooden mushroom wearing the expression of someone who has read the group chat.

name: Respectfully, No. Cross-Stitch
desc: Miniature cross-stitch combining impeccable floral borders with excellent boundary setting.

name: Tiny Ceramic Sardine Dish
desc: A thumb-sized platter for rings, salt, paper clips, or dramatic single olives.

name: Emergency Dance Break Token
desc: A pocket token redeemable, spiritually if not legally, for one song immediately.

name: The Meeting Could Be Pottery Mug
desc: Speckled mug for meetings improved markedly by trimming bowls instead.

name: Tiny Shrine to Snacks
